title: PCSO lotto results Oct. 8: ₱85.48M jackpot not won
summary: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱85.48 million jackpot in the Lotto 6/42 draw or the ₱40.17 million jackpot in the Super Lotto 6/49 draw on Thursday, Oct. 8, 2026, according to the…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱85.48 million jackpot in the Lotto 6/42 draw or the ₱40.17 million jackpot in the Super Lotto 6/49 draw on Thursday, Oct. 8, 2026, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Lotto 6/42 draw produced the winning combination 19-01-20-39-23-11, with a jackpot prize of ₱85.48 million.
